lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns. A prominent pair of vertically aligned, high-luminance blobs is positioned approximately one pectoral-fin width posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a distinctive grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, non-linear 'maze' pattern composed of high-luminance lines and spots is situated just posterior to the uppermost gill slit area.
